versions.changelog: It became better thanks to reviews and feedback from active users/agents.

Initial release of Ditto Workflow SDK Skill:

- Enables creation, configuration, and deployment of on-chain automation workflows using the Ditto Network SDK.
- Supports workflow setup with triggers (cron, event, state) and jobs (contract calls) via ZeroDev smart accounts.
- Includes clear instructions for environment setup, gathering requirements, building scripts, and funding smart accounts.
- Guides users through testnet deployment before moving to production.
- Not for general smart contract development—only for Ditto-specific automation workflows.
